## Design

### 2026-10-17 – In this session, I worked on getting my Onshape software running and exploring some of the features that will be used for this marble run project.  I started with a square base that has a measurement

**3h**

In this session, I worked on getting my Onshape software running and exploring some of the features that will be used for this marble run project.  I started with a square base that has a measurement of 100 mm by 100 mm with a 4mm thickness. For the base, I had to use the sketch tool, dimension tool, and extrude function. Next, I worked on designing a simple straight track that used circles and the dimension tool to make the proportions correct. One tool I found very useful when designing the simple track was the mirror tool which allowed me to make the exact line/shape appear on the opposite side of the chosen line/shape. The task of creating the track also involved the sweep tool that allows the extrusion to follow a path/line. One thing that I found difficult to interpret was the offset plane which created another surface to draw the line that will operate the sweep function. So after analyzing it, I see that the surface is listed as "Plane 1" or similar which helped me distinguish the surfaces easily.
